reasoning: The icon depicts a wheeled carry-on bag or trolley crossed out by a diagonal slash, indicating 'no luggage' or a 'no cabin bag' fare class. Because the slash obscures the top corners of the suitcase, the silhouette is quite hard to read at small sizes and easily confused with a wheeled trash bin or hand truck. Its use in to-do lists is narrow, fitting mainly tasks about basic-economy no-baggage flights, ultralight packing, or venue bag bans.
